note: Islamic History order game. Every year (CE) is stated by the named source (Wikipedia or Britannica) and was cross-checked on 20 Nov 2026 against Britannica and other independent sources; 'basis' says what the source states. Days are shown only where independent sources agree. Left out because sources disagree or give no date: Jerusalem (637 or 638), Yarmouk, Karbala, Qadisiyyah, the Great Mosque of Damascus. Not yet reviewed by a named scholar.

events.label: Abu Bakr becomes the first caliph
events.basis: The page gives the succession to Muhammad ﷺ as 632.

events.label: Umar takes power as caliph
events.basis: The page says he took power on 23 August 634.

events.label: Alexandria surrendered by treaty
events.basis: The page says the treaty was signed on 8 November 641.

events.label: Uthman is elected caliph
events.basis: The page gives the election of Uthman as 644.

events.label: Ali is elected caliph
events.basis: The page gives the election of Ali as 656.

events.label: Mu'awiya becomes caliph: the Umayyad Caliphate begins
events.basis: The page says he became caliph in 661.

events.label: The Dome of the Rock is completed
Tariq ibn Ziyad wins at Guadalete
events.basis: The page says Roderic's army was defeated on 19 July 711. The year is firm; the day (19 July) is only traditional, so the game shows the year.

events.label: The Battle of Tours
events.basis: The page gives the Battle of Tours as 732.

events.label: The Abbasids rise to power
events.basis: Britannica: the Abbasids overthrew the Umayyad caliphate in 750 CE.

events.label: The Battle of Talas
events.basis: The page gives the Battle of Talas as 751.

events.label: Al-Mansur founds Baghdad
events.basis: Britannica: the true founding of Baghdad dates to 762, when al-Mansur chose the site.

events.label: The Fatimid Caliphate is founded
events.basis: The page says al-Mahdi became the first caliph and founder in 909.

events.label: Cairo is founded under the Fatimids
events.basis: The page gives the founding of Cairo as 969.

events.label: Saladin wins the Battle of Hattin
events.basis: The page gives 4 July 1187; Jerusalem surrendered to Saladin on 2 October 1187.

events.label: The Mongols sack Baghdad
events.basis: The page says the sack began on 13 February 1258. Britannica also gives 1258 for the Mongol destruction of the Abbasid caliphate.

events.label: The Mamluks win at Ain Jalut
events.basis: The page's infobox gives 3 September 1260 (26 Ramadan 658 H).
